name: Oran's Gratitude
summary: After Rin'ji's Secret, the chain that began with Rin'ji is Trapped! comes to its close with Oran Snakewrithe, to whom you bring a tablet.

sections.title: A Tablet for Oran
sections.body: Rin'ji is Trapped! began this chain, and Rin'ji's Secret was the step just before this one. Oran Snakewrithe is the one who receives the tablet you carry.

sections.title: Oran's Answer
sections.body: Oran asks where the tablet turned up, and you tell of a small island, deserted, at the Overlook Cliffs. Oran finds this very interesting, puts the tablet carefully away, and says the Dark Lady will be very pleased with the discovery.

faq.answer: Oran Snakewrithe is the one who closes the chain that began with Rin'ji is Trapped! and went on through Rin'ji's Secret.

faq.q: What comes before this in the chain?
faq.answer: Before it comes Rin'ji's Secret, and before that Rin'ji is Trapped!.
